abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by severe hypoxia and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, which contribute to poor therapeutic responses. This study developed sialic acid-targeting Lectin-conjugated oxygen nanosomes (Lectin-ONs) to combine targeted oxygen delivery with hypoxia alleviation and macrophage activation.
METHODS: SNA- and MALII-conjugated oxygen nanosomes (SNA-ONs and MALII-ONs) were prepared and characterized for physicochemical properties, oxygen-loading and release behavior, stability, cytocompatibility, and cellular binding. Their effects on hypoxia and macrophage activation were evaluated in pancreatic cancer cell models and macrophage-pancreatic cancer cell co-culture using hypoxia-sensitive fluorescence and TNF-α secretion, respectively.
RESULTS: Lectin-ONs exhibited stable physicochemical properties, effective oxygen delivery, and cellular binding to pancreatic cancer cells, while reducing hypoxia-associated fluorescence under oxygen-limited conditions. Treatment with Lectin-ONs also increased TNF-α secretion in macrophage-pancreatic cancer cell co-culture, consistent with macrophage activation.
CONCLUSION: Lectin-ONs integrate sialic acid-targeted delivery with oxygen-mediated hypoxia alleviation and were associated with increased macrophage TNF-α secretion in vitro. These findings support Lectin-ONs as a potential platform for modulating the hypoxic and immunosuppressive microenvironment of pancreatic cancer, although further mechanistic and in vivo validation is required.
key_points_ko: 시알산 표적 렉틴 접합 산소 나노좀(Lectin-ONs)은 췌장암 세포에 안정적으로 결합하여 산소를 전달했습니다.
산소 결핍 환경의 췌장암 세포 모델에서 저산소증 관련 형광 신호를 감소시켰습니다.
대식세포와 췌장암 세포 공동 배양 조건에서 대식세포 활성화를 나타내는 TNF-α 분비 증가를 유도했습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌관선암(PDAC)의 심각한 저산소증과 면역 억제성 미세환경을 개선하기 위해 시알산(sialic acid)을 표적하는 렉틴 접합 산소 나노좀(Lectin-ONs)을 개발하여 평가했습니다. 연구진은 SNA 및 MALII 렉틴을 결합한 산소 나노좀을 제작하고, 췌장암 세포주 및 대식세포 공동 배양 모델을 통해 저산소증 완화와 면역 반응을 측정했습니다. 실험 결과 나노좀은 췌장암 세포에 효과적으로 결합해 저산소 상태를 개선했으며, 대식세포의 종양괴사인자 알파(TNF-α) 분비를 증가시켰습니다. 본 결과는 저산소 및 면역 억제 미세환경을 조절하는 플랫폼으로서의 가능성을 보여주었으나 생체 내(in vivo) 추가 검증이 필요합니다.
title: Sialic Acid-Targeting Lectin-Conjugated Oxygen Nanosomes Alleviate Hypoxia and Promote Macrophage Activation in Pancreatic Cancer Cells
